guidetextdraw._value:
UPS 330.164: Posthumous Degree and Recognition

Students who, at the time of their death or prior to an illness or accident that leads to their death, were in good academic standing in a degree program may be awarded a posthumous degree by the President.

The purpose of the posthumous degree is a recognition of the academic achievement of the student, as well as a statement of their value to the California State University, Fullerton community.

When determining whether to grant a degree under this policy, the President will consider recommendations from the Chair, Coordinator, or Director of the program for which the degree is being conferred.
